title: Kiritani Haruka — Hope Delivered〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

meta.Event: To One Day Reach that Flowery Stage

rows.Line: Stage SEKAI
Flower Field

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I'm glad the sky's still the same beautiful blue as last time.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Me too! It only drizzles a bit here, so we can have picnics without worrying about it raining cats and dogs!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Cats and dogs?
I'd heard that you don't exactly have the best luck, Minori, but still...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
I know, right?
And yet it's been torrential on our side today.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Incredibly windy as well...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
I had no idea...
That's pretty incredible if you think about it...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: But like Haruka said, we have such beautiful clear skies here. So, let's enjoy our picnic, shall we♪

rows.Speaker: Minori & Rin
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Actually, when can we start having those rice balls and sandwiches you all brought over?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Probably after we've had another chance to take a look around this place.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: We did all end up coming at different times when it was initially discovered.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Right. And there may be some glowing flowers that we haven't found yet.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: The flowers we found helped us a ton, so we should find any that are still out there.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Okay! Then, those rice balls and sandwiches will just have to wait until a little later.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Hm? Miku?
You look a bit disappointed.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
What?! M-MEIKO!
Please don't make it sound like I'm that hungry or something...!

rows.Speaker: Minori, Airi, Haruka & Shizuku
rows.Line:
Haha!
Hehe.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Anyway, everyone, let's start exploring.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Roger!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Also, ta-daa!
I borrowed an encyclopedia about flowers from the school's library!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Oh, that should help us greatly in terms of identifying the flowers here!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yes, it should♪

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Oh, Minori!
What about this red one? Its leaves look really unique...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
This orange one is also interesting.
It's very similar to a dahlia, but...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Oh, you're right...
Even when you stick your hand in, it doesn't get wet.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: See what I mean?! How cool is that?!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh, why don't we have our picnic here?
We should be able to lay out our blanket without crushing any of the flowers.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Hehe. Okay.
Then, let's call the others over♪

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
I'll go.
You two keep setting everything up.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehe. Exploring and having a picnic here as a group was so much fun!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Now that you mention it, I really enjoyed our picnic.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Yeah.
I had a lot of fun too.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Me as well. Especially since I got to go for a walk with everyone in such a beautiful place like this.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I also had a lot of fun♪

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Me too♪

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Anyway, this seems like a good time for us to break out the food.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yay♪

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: You're both making it seem like this is the main event cheering like that.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm glad to see that you're so excited!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
So, here are the sandwiches I made!
You've got your choice of BLT, ham and fruit!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Wow, they all look delicious...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I also made some sandwiches!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Let's see... These are egg salad, these have strawberry jam in them and these are the marmalade ones!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Oh, these all look so wonderful.
They're so colorful and aesthetically pleasing♪

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
I've got rice balls over here.
You can choose from plum, salmon and red perilla leaf seasoning.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
I also made some rice balls.
Mine have bonito flakes, tuna and mustard greens in them.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Wow! You girls made all these for us?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
We really appreciate it.
Now, where to begin...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
*Nod*
It must've taken you girls a lot of time and effort to make all this.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I had fun making mine since I ran a few taste tests along the way.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Also, the thought of seeing you all smile excited me so much that my hands basically went on autopilot.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Same here!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Hehe. You put in all this effort just for us. I suppose we shouldn't expect any less from you girls.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yes, thank you all very much♪

rows.Speaker: Rin, Len, Luka & MEIKO
rows.Line:
Thank you♪
Thank you!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Anyway, shall we get started?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Ready?!

rows.Speaker: Everyone
rows.Line: Let's eat!
